_comment: Program profiles (engine/program.js). The instructor picks a program once; it sets defaults for every sim (settings, staff, assessment tools), which cases and saved sims are offered (patient tags), what's offered in pickers, which features the setup screens show, and wording. A program never removes content the engine needs: a case or sim from another program still runs. Everything here is a draft for the instructor (SPEC §14). Room for EMT / Paramedic: add a profile with its own terms (e.g. clinician 'medic'), staff roles and features.

programs.label: RN (registered nurse)
programs.description: Registered nursing: full assessment, delegation to LPNs and CNAs, every feature.

programs.label: LPN / LVN (practical nurse)
programs.description: Practical nursing: cases tagged LPN, delegation to CNAs only, focused assessment tools.
